notes.title: Optimization and Bugs Update + New Developer Title!
notes.content:
Hiya! After the release of our other title:[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1037330/Senpai_Teaches_Me_Japanese_Part_1/] Senpai Teaches me Japanese: Part 1[/url]
we have come back to show our first game a little bit of love!

For the past few days we worked to update both of our titles, in Eurobi Racing specifically we:

• Made under the hood improvements and optimizations to the code
• Performed some small bug fixes

We hope this update fixes the leaderboards issue for good, as before they worked sometimes and not other times (a tricky issue to solve!!).

Cheers all, and look forward to future updates as we push those out as well!
